status: No newly accepted plaintext; the truncation hypothesis remains open

source.raw_source_grouped: AAGVG VVDAG GAGAV AGGAA VAXGV AAAXF AAXAF AGVGV VVVVG DADAF GDVGV GVGAD XAGAA GXGGA GVFVG XGXAG GGAFA XGFXX AGXVG VFDVX VDFGX V

source_interpretation: 106 is handwritten, while RICHI is typed. Both call signs are absent and no transmitted numeric length or part number survives. A complete 106-coordinate cryptogram is a hypothesis, not a source fact.

search_scope.offsets: Every integer 0 through complete length minus 106, inclusive
search_scope.geometry: Ordinary columnar transposition; a single unchanged contiguous received fragment inside an otherwise erased complete ciphertext
search_scope.retention: Top 100 per key in each of four pools: all, prefix, suffix, and at least 12 fixed letters with a fixed run of at least 5

ranking.formula: sum(log marginal probability of each coordinate pattern) + one quarter of the sum of four-pattern log correlation ratios
ranking.pattern_index: 7*row + column, with index 6 for an unknown coordinate
ranking.unassigned_square_cells: Uniform average over unused symbols for ranking only; repeated-cell dependence is not modeled

controls.model: Identical fixed Nov7-9 marginal score and exhaustive 106..600 geometry as the target scan
controls.validation_limit: These are implementation and ranking-sensitivity controls, not out-of-sample validation. A normalized version of their p171 source body occurs 15 times in the upstream military vocabulary file.

limits: Only the stated 21 fixed keys and normal rank convention are tested here; other independent experiments have separate reports.
Only even complete lengths 106 through 600 and contiguous prefix/suffix losses are covered.
No internal deletion, symbol substitution, coordinate-label permutation, or arbitrary unknown transposition is tested in this branch.
The geometric enumeration is exhaustive within these bounds; language ranking and acceptance of a readable candidate remain heuristic.
A high-ranked true geometry can reveal no complete plaintext letters, as demonstrated by the long-suffix control.
The two synthetic controls use a body represented in the upstream training vocabulary; they measure implementation and sensitivity, not blind accuracy.
